og.title: A Double Victory for Web Speed: Chrome Breaks Records Again on Speedometer 3.1 and Jetstream 3
og.description: Chrome has introduced significant performance improvements for WebAssembly workloads by optimizing V8's internal data structures, SIMD instructions, and register allocation to better accelerate AI and cryptography use cases. Furthermore, enhanced memory reuse during compilation and reduced overhead for JavaScript-to-WebAssembly function calls have further streamlined overall execution speeds.

og.title: Bringing a clearer, more consistent HDR video experience to Chrome
og.description: Mixing High Dynamic Range (HDR) and standard video on the same screen often results in washed-out or blown-out images due to vastly different display brightness capabilities. To fix this, Google teamed up with Apple and NBCUniversal to create a new technical standard (SMPTE ST 2094-50) that uses adaptive metadata to ensure HDR content looks exactly as its creator intended across any device or lighting condition.
